purpose: Matrix of pattern candidates and current control coverage.

entries.title: Numeric representation assumptions escaped their valid domain
positive_controls_needed: At least one caught-before-harm unit/range/precision control case is still needed; Gimli is a positive control but not a prevention success.
negative_controls_needed: Add software or engineering incidents with serious outcomes where numeric representation was present but not explanatory, to prevent the pattern from absorbing all technical failure.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least one positive control, at least one negative control, an explicit counterexample search, and a rollback/split decision recorded in the claim-status ledger.

entries.title: Safety warnings lose force when proof burden flips under schedule, production, certification, or metric pressure
positive_controls_needed: Add another official investigation in which pre-event warnings existed and were weakened by authority, schedule, production, certification, or metric pressure.
negative_controls_needed: Add a high-consequence failure with no meaningful pre-event warning signal, to keep the pattern from becoming hindsight bias.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least one positive control, at least one negative control, an explicit counterexample search, and a rollback/split decision recorded in the claim-status ledger.

entries.title: Plausible positive proxy routes failed under hard endpoints
positive_controls_needed: Add additional medical cases where a plausible proxy or observational route failed under hard randomized patient-relevant endpoints.
negative_controls_needed: Add cases where surrogate or observational evidence correctly predicted hard-endpoint net benefit under later trials.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least one positive control, at least one negative control, an explicit counterexample search, and a rollback/split decision recorded in the claim-status ledger.

entries.title: Program audits convert broad field promises into accountable scope
positive_controls_needed: Add another formal program audit where a broad research-program promise was narrowed by evaluator evidence while narrower work remained valid.
negative_controls_needed: Add a program audit that was later judged too pessimistic or methodologically weak.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least one positive control, at least one negative control, an explicit counterexample search, and a rollback/split decision recorded in the claim-status ledger.

entries.title: Confidential signal commons turn weak, identity-sensitive warnings into shared safety knowledge
positive_controls_needed: Add additional confidential or de-identified reporting infrastructures from safety-critical domains.
negative_controls_needed: Add open/non-confidential reporting systems and failed confidential channels to distinguish confidentiality from trust, analysis, and action routing.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least one positive control, at least one negative control, an explicit counterexample search, and a rollback/split decision recorded in the claim-status ledger.

entries.title: Denominator visibility rails make study plans, result status, and later corrections queryable without making them complete
positive_controls_needed: Add additional registries, preregistration platforms, and correction-memory systems with distinct governance models.
negative_controls_needed: Add cases where a registry existed but reporting remained incomplete or low quality.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least one positive control, at least one negative control, an explicit counterexample search, and a rollback/split decision recorded in the claim-status ledger.

entries.title: Audit pairs reveal the file drawer by comparing hidden denominators with published numerators
positive_controls_needed: Add additional paired-audit studies comparing a hidden denominator surface with a published numerator surface.
negative_controls_needed: Add paired audits showing little or no publication/reporting bias in a specific domain or period.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least one positive control, at least one negative control, an explicit counterexample search, and a rollback/split decision recorded in the claim-status ledger.

entries.title: Software control-plane changes can fail at speed when validation, monitoring, deployment, and rollback are not independent
positive_controls_needed: Add additional software/IT failures in which control-plane or privileged changes propagated faster than independent validation/monitoring/rollback could contain.
negative_controls_needed: Add software failures caused by demand load, hardware, adversarial exploitation, or physical infrastructure rather than change propagation.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least one positive control, at least one negative control, an explicit counterexample search, and a rollback/split decision recorded in the claim-status ledger.

entries.title: Software opacity creates attribution traps when harmed outsiders cannot inspect decisive internal state
positive_controls_needed: Add additional records where hidden software state produced external attribution against operators, patients, users, regulators, or the public.
negative_controls_needed: Add records where transparent logs, independent audit access, or adversarial testing prevented misattribution.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least one positive control, at least one negative control, an explicit counterexample search, and a rollback/split decision recorded in the claim-status ledger.

entries.title: Multi-lab replications convert single-effect claims into effect-size and boundary-condition maps
positive_controls_needed: Add additional multi-lab efforts that convert a single-effect claim into an effect-size and boundary-condition map.
negative_controls_needed: Add multi-lab efforts with robust replication to avoid teaching that replication only means debunking.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least one positive control, at least one negative control, an explicit counterexample search, and a rollback/split decision recorded in the claim-status ledger.

entries.title: Practice adoption can outrun hard evidence; de-adoption needs a correction surface separate from the negative result itself
positive_controls_needed: Add more cases where adoption outran hard evidence and de-adoption required a separate correction surface.
negative_controls_needed: Add practices that de-adopted quickly after negative evidence, and negative results that did not warrant de-adoption because subgroup indications remained.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least one positive control, at least one negative control, an explicit counterexample search, and a rollback/split decision recorded in the claim-status ledger.

entries.title: Correction memory does not equal correction infusion
positive_controls_needed: A source-backed case where a lesson/recommendation repository or action-tracking system measurably changed a process, checklist, design, or policy before recurrence.
negative_controls_needed: A correction-memory system with high documented uptake and effective application, to avoid assuming repositories fail by default.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least three systems, one current audit/outcome trace, one positive control, one negative control, and explicit split/merge decision.

entries.title: Candidate-mechanism plausibility can outrun denominator-scale association evidence
positive_controls_needed: First positive-control pass is present, but second-pass review must decide whether APOE, HLA-B*5701/abacavir, and ADH1B/ALDH2 are comparable controls or belong in distinct subfamilies.
negative_controls_needed: Add at least one negative/control contrast where candidate plausibility and a tight phenotype did not survive denominator-scale testing.
Add at least one case where a narrow-denominator genetic finding transferred robustly across populations after careful testing.
Add at least one therapy-target genetic positive that later failed clinical translation, if source-acquired.
entries.maturity_blocker: Positive controls, negative controls, ancestry/phenotype caveat records, a split/merge memo, and second-pass source review of every direct supporting claim.

entries.title: Evidence scope follows denominator diversity, portability, and governance
positive_controls_needed: A case where diverse training data or governance measurably improved portability or reduced inequity.
A non-genomics domain where denominator diversity changed model/claim portability.
negative_controls_needed: A case where European-ancestry-heavy discovery nevertheless transferred robustly across groups after careful testing.
A case where diverse recruitment did not improve portability because phenotype, environment, or measurement quality dominated.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least three genomics cases, two non-genomics analogues, one negative control, one positive intervention/control case, and a methods/source-code audit for dynamic monitor sources.

entries.title: Extraordinary anomaly discipline requires instrument-chain audit, independent controls, versioned provenance, and scope narrowing
positive_controls_needed: A second surviving-anomaly positive control outside gravitational-wave physics.
A case where versioned provenance and independent retest prevented premature overclaiming before public amplification.
negative_controls_needed: A case with extensive instrumentation where anomaly discipline alone did not settle status because decisive data stayed private, classified, or proprietary.
A case where an extraordinary claim survived initial checks but was later narrowed by theory rather than by instrument/foreground/replication controls.
entries.maturity_blocker: Controls and second-pass review required.

entries.title: Nuclear severe-accident correction requires design-basis humility, operating-experience memory, and emergency information rails
positive_controls_needed: A nuclear near-miss or event where operating-experience memory demonstrably prevented recurrence.
A plant/regulator change record showing a design-basis or severe-accident-management lesson infused into equipment, procedures, exercises, and inspection before a stressor occurred.
negative_controls_needed: A severe nuclear event where design-basis or OPEX rails were present but not explanatory.
A high-risk non-nuclear system with similar external-hazard design-basis challenge to test whether this is nuclear-specific or a general engineered-system pattern.
entries.maturity_blocker: Controls and second-pass review required.

entries.title: Process-safety correction requires barrier-health visibility, inventory/offsite-consequence discipline, and learning rails
positive_controls_needed: A process-safety near miss or intervention where leading indicators/barrier-health metrics demonstrably prevented escalation.
A recommendation-closure record showing CSB/PSM/RMP/CCPS-derived changes infused into procedures, inspections, design, and training before a later stressor.
negative_controls_needed: A chemical/process incident where barrier-health metrics and process-safety rails were strong and the main cause was outside this pattern.
A major release where inventory/offsite consequence was obvious but emergency planning and regulation were not the limiting factors.
entries.maturity_blocker: Controls and second-pass review required.

entries.title: Structural load-path, review, inspection, and records assumptions can fail before critical state becomes legible
positive_controls_needed: A structural hazard detected by peer review, load rating, inspection, confidential reporting, or records audit before failure.
A recommendation/code-change record showing that lessons from a prior structural failure measurably changed later design or inspection practice.
negative_controls_needed: A collapse where load-path/review/inspection/records rails were adequate and the dominant cause lies outside this pattern.
A structural failure caused primarily by an external extreme hazard beyond design basis rather than hidden critical-state legibility.
entries.maturity_blocker: Controls and second-pass review required.

entries.title: Stored-material impoundments fail when material state, hydraulic state, construction history, and consequence exposure are not legible enough
positive_controls_needed: Impoundment/dam where high-risk material/hydraulic state was detected and corrected before failure.
Tailings facility with documented GISTM/independent-review intervention that changed design, water management, or emergency planning before harm.
negative_controls_needed: Dam/tailings failure where visible material/hydraulic/construction-state issues are not explanatory and a different dominant mechanism controls.
Stable impoundment with similar upstream/construction/material features but robust controls and no failure.
entries.maturity_blocker: Controls and second-pass review required.

entries.title: Flight-deck state becomes unsafe when aircraft state, automation mode, crew coordination, and training surfaces diverge
positive_controls_needed: Add Qantas 32, British Airways 009, or other source-backed cases where CRM, cross-checking, automation understanding, or procedural discipline helped convert abnormal state into survival.
Add near-miss/confidential-report examples where state divergence was caught before harm.
negative_controls_needed: Add a commercial-aviation accident where flight-deck coordination/state divergence was present but not causal, to prevent hindsight overfit.
Add a primarily structural/mechanical accident where crew response was competent and non-explanatory.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least two positive controls, at least one negative control, at least one near-miss/prevention control, and a recommendation/training-infusion child record per major support family.

entries.title: Marine casualty state becomes dangerous when watertight integrity, stability, navigation, bridge/team state, and evacuation/investigation rails diverge
positive_controls_needed: Add a passenger-vessel casualty or near-miss where watertight integrity, stability calculation, bridge state, and evacuation rails worked as intended and limited harm.
Add a controlled-success record after SOLAS/ro-ro or safety-management reforms to test correction infusion.
negative_controls_needed: Add a marine casualty where watertight/stability/evacuation state was legible and not explanatory, to prevent overfitting.
Add a non-passenger cargo casualty where pattern axes are present but not causally dominant.
entries.maturity_blocker: At least two near-miss/controlled-success controls, at least one negative control, at least one recommendation/code-closure record, and one vessel-class contrast outside ro-ro/passenger cases.
